newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl Oriental buys HK$89 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Pearl Oriental buys HK$89 mln property.

text.p: Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had bought a residential site from Kong Tai International Holdings Co Ltd in Hong Kong's Sheung Shui Town Centre for HK$89 million, including debt liability.
Pearl Oriental said in a statement the site was of an area of 5,450 square feet with a residential gross floor area of about 30,000 square feet after construction.
The average cost per square feet of gross floor area approximated HK$2,966.

The planned residential development included 45 residential units of about 666 square feet each with swimming pool and podium garden. The project is expected to be completed at the end of 1998, it said.
